yotta-guardian 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a deterministic rule engine with pluggable intent verification for intercepting high-risk tool calls (exec, write, edit, read, run, shell).
- Provides audit logging for all intercepted actions and reports rule triggers transparently.
- Supports configurable policies (default, strict, loose) and allows user-specified overrides.
- Does not replace user decisions or hide audit records; default is read-only evaluation without auto-execution or bypass.
- Compatible with Python 3.8+, works on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
